poster_says.title: Windows: tide sync fails on paths longer than 260 characters
poster_says.task:
tide sync aborts with ENAMETOOLONG on Windows for deep folders.

Wanted: long paths sync on Windows. Done means the long-path case in sync_test.go passes on a Windows runner.

What I tried: nothing; I have no Windows machine.
